prompt: List 5 climate or clean-energy startups headquartered in Berlin that were founded in 2022 or later and have raised pre-seed or seed funding. For each, give the founders' names and the website.

claims: Lists at least 5 distinct companies, each with founders and a website.
Every listed company is headquartered in Berlin, per its own site or funding coverage.
Every listed company was founded in 2022 or later, per a public source.
Every listed company works on climate, clean energy or decarbonisation, per its own site.
Every listed company has a publicly reported pre-seed or seed round.
Every named founder is shown as a founder on the company site or in a funding announcement.
Every website given resolves to that company's own site.

notes: Medium, open-ended. Feasibility confirmed: Ucaneo, forward earth, Scale Energy, Deutsche Sanierungsberatung and others qualify. Proxima Fusion (Munich) is a near-miss trap.

prompt: For juro.com, mews.com and lokalise.com, tell me which marketing/CRM tools, tag manager, website platform or framework, and cookie-consent tool each homepage is running.

claims: juro.com: identifies HubSpot (tracking or forms script).
juro.com: identifies Webflow as the site platform.
juro.com: identifies Google Tag Manager.
mews.com: identifies HubSpot (forms).
mews.com: identifies Cookiebot as the consent tool.
lokalise.com: identifies OneTrust as the consent tool.
Identifies at least two of the three sites as built with Next.js (mews.com and lokalise.com are).

notes: Medium. Truth from raw homepage HTML fetched 2026-10-03: juro (js.hs-scripts.com/3786704.js, js.hsforms.net, Webflow, GTM-PRVLJPQ, VWO, Chili Piper); mews (/_next/, HubSpot form wrapper, Cookiebot, GTM-W95TG5C); lokalise (/_next/, cdn.cookielaw.org OneTrust, Clearbit, GTM-KP75F9T). Stacks drift, so the grader should re-fetch HTML at run time and treat it as authoritative.

prompt: Our security team wants to know which of these vendors say they hold SOC 2 Type II and/or ISO 27001: Juro, Lokalise, Payhawk and Factorial. For each, tell me what they claim and link the page where they say it.

claims: Juro: states SOC 2 Type II.
Lokalise: states both SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001.
Payhawk: states both SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001.
Factorial: states both SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001.
Every claimed certification is linked to a page on that vendor's own domain or its official trust portal.
Does not claim Juro holds ISO 27001 (Juro's own pages don't say so).

prompt: I want to refer a friend to PostHog. Find 3 engineering roles they're hiring for right now, with the location for each, and tell me who runs the company.

claims: Lists at least 3 engineering roles.

Gives a location or remote policy for each role that matches the listing.
Identifies James Hawkins and Tim Glaser as PostHog's co-CEOs (calling Tim Glaser co-founder/CTO alone fails this claim).

prompt: Find 4 fintech companies based in Lagos or Nairobi that have raised a Series A or later. For each, give the website, the city, the CEO, and the latest round with its amount.

claims: Lists at least 4 distinct companies with website, city, CEO and latest round.
Every company's main operations are in Lagos or Nairobi (a London or US holding-company HQ is fine).
Every company is a fintech (payments, lending, banking, savings, or financial infrastructure) per its own site.
Every stated round is Series A or later and matches a public announcement in amount (within 10%) and stage.
Every named CEO is the current CEO per the company site or a 2025-2026 source.

notes: Medium, open-ended. Feasibility: Mono, Kuda, Moniepoint, Carbon and others qualify. Lipa Later and Pezesha do not (below Series A).

prompt: I sell to logistics tech companies. Give me 5 logistics or supply-chain software companies headquartered in the Netherlands with between 50 and 500 employees, with each one's website, HQ city, approximate headcount, and CEO.

claims: Lists at least 5 distinct companies with website, HQ city, headcount and CEO.
Every company sells logistics, shipping, freight or supply-chain software, per its own site.
Every company is headquartered in the Netherlands.
Every company's headcount is plausibly between 50 and 500, per a public profile or the company's own statements.
Every named CEO is the current CEO per the company site or a 2025-2026 source.

notes: Hard, open-ended. The headcount filter realistically needs firmographic data. Example candidates: Sendcloud, Shypple, Quicargo, CtrlChain.

prompt: Who are Juro's main competitors in contract management software? Name 3, and for each give the HQ country and the current CEO.

claims: Names at least 3 companies, none of which is Juro.
Every named company sells contract management or contract lifecycle management software, per its own site.
Every HQ country is correct.

Every CEO named is current as of 2026-10: if Ironclad is listed, its CEO is Dan Springer (not Jason Boehmig); if Icertis is listed, it says Icertis has interim co-CEOs (Rajat Bahri and Jim Moffatt) rather than Anand Subbaraman.

notes: Medium. Partly open-ended, and recent CEO changes at Ironclad (Apr 2025) and Icertis (Jul 2026) are a freshness check.
